Second, intention and welfare: an action has a universal side (an arsonist cannot plead he lit only one square inch of wood), and I may seek my own satisfaction in it. Third, the good and conscience. Hegel praises Kant for grounding duty in free will but calls 'duty for duty's sake' empty formalism: Kant's test finds a contradiction only if content, such as property, is presupposed. Conscience is the subject's certainty of the good; held merely formally, it can set its own particularity above the universal: evil. Good and conscience stay abstract; their unity is ethical life.
explain.zh: 道德（Moralität）是主观意志的法。其一，故意与责任：在行为的诸多后果中，我只把自己所知、所故意的部分认作我的行动。其二，意图与福利：行动有普遍的一面（纵火者不能辩称自己只点着了一小块木头），我也有权在行动中寻求自己的满足。其三，善与良心。黑格尔赞赏康德把义务建立在自由意志上，却批评“为义务而义务”是空洞的形式主义：普遍化检验只有预设了财产之类的内容，才找得出矛盾。良心是主体对善的确信；若只停留于形式，它就可能把自己的特殊性置于普遍之上，这就是恶。善与良心都还抽象，它们的统一是伦理。

example.en: Oedipus kills an old man at a crossroads, not knowing he is his father. Hegel says he cannot be charged with parricide: the deed includes the father, but his action, what he knew and intended, does not. Greek tragedy, by contrast, made the hero answer for the whole deed. And Kant's maxim 'keep a deposit when no one can prove it' contradicts itself only if we already assume that property ought to exist.
example.zh: 俄狄浦斯在十字路口杀了一个老人，不知道那是他父亲。黑格尔说，不能控告他弑父：“行为”里包括了父亲，他的“行动”即他所知所愿却不包括。希腊悲剧则相反，让英雄为全部行为负责。再看康德的准则“没人能证明时就吞掉寄存物”：只有在已经假定财产应当存在时，它才自相矛盾。

image.en: A signpost stands at a crossroads by a heap of stones, its arms pointing to Thebes and Delphi. A crowned old man lies in the dust beside it. A young traveller strides off the other way, sword at his side, untroubled; his thought bubble says only 'a stranger'. The moral question hangs in that bubble: what did he know?
image.zh: 十字路口的石堆旁立着一块路牌，一边指向忒拜，一边指向德尔斐。一位戴王冠的老人倒在路边尘土里。一个年轻旅人佩着剑，若无其事地朝另一个方向走去；他的思想泡泡里只写着“陌生人”。道德的问题就悬在这个泡泡里：他当时知道什么？

means.en: the right of knowledge: I answer for what I knew
means.zh: 认知的法：我只对所知负责

means.en: the deed's full consequence: a father unknown to him
means.zh: 行为的全部后果：他不认识的父亲

means.en: action (Handlung): only what was known and willed
means.zh: 行动（Handlung）：只含所知所愿

means.en: the subject's own choice and responsibility
means.zh: 主体自己的选择与责任

summary.en: Freedom as the living good: customs and institutions in which right and morality are united and individuals feel at home.
summary.zh: 自由作为活的善：法与道德在风俗和制度中统一，个人在其中感到自在。

explain.en: Abstract right gave freedom outward existence without inwardness; morality gave inwardness without content. Ethical life is their unity and truth, 'the Idea of freedom as the living good'. The good is no longer a mere ought: it exists in customs, laws and institutions, and individuals recognise these as their own essence, not as alien commands. Once habitual, the ethical becomes a second nature. Its duties restrict only drives and empty reflection; in duty, Hegel says, the individual finds his liberation. Asked how best to raise a son ethically, a Pythagorean replied: make him a citizen of a state with good laws. Ethical life unfolds as family, civil society and state. The Phenomenology's Greek ethical world was its immediate, unreflective form.
explain.zh: 抽象法给了自由外在的定在却缺少内在性，道德有了内在性却缺少内容。伦理是二者的统一与真理，即“作为活的善的自由理念”。善不再只是应当，而是存在于风俗、法律和制度之中；个人把它们认作自己的本质，而非外来的命令。习以为常之后，伦理成为第二天性。伦理义务限制的只是冲动和空洞的反思；黑格尔说，个人在义务中反而获得解放。有人问怎样最好地教育儿子，一位毕达哥拉斯派回答：让他成为法律良好的国家的公民。伦理展开为家庭、市民社会和国家。《精神现象学》中的希腊伦理世界是它直接的、尚未经过反思的形态。

example.en: You do not derive from first principles that you should stop at a red light, visit your sick grandmother or pay your taxes. You grow up inside practices that already embody these goods, and on reflection you can endorse them as your own. When the practices are rational, keeping them feels like freedom rather than obedience. The lonely moralist who asks 'what ought I to do?' from scratch is the exception, not the rule.
example.zh: 你不会从第一原理推出该在红灯前停车、该去探望生病的祖母、该纳税。你在早已体现这些善的习俗中长大，反思之后又能把它们认作自己的。如果这些习俗是合理的，遵守它们就像自由，而不像服从。从零开始追问“我应当做什么”的孤独道德家，是例外而非常态。

image.en: Under the throne room's banners six citizens dance a ring around a tall flagpole, arms raised, never glancing at their feet or at a rulebook: the steps are second nature. From the side a father leads his small son by the hand towards the ring, following the Pythagorean's advice: make him a citizen of a state with good laws.
image.zh: 王座厅的旗帜下，六位市民绕着一根高高的旗杆跳圆圈舞，双臂高举，从不低头看脚，也不翻规则手册：舞步已是第二天性。一旁，一位父亲牵着小儿子走向舞圈，照毕达哥拉斯派的建议：让他成为法律良好的国家的公民。

means.en: custom: freedom lived together as second nature
means.zh: 风俗：共同生活中的自由，已成第二天性

means.en: shared institutions the life turns around
means.zh: 生活所环绕的共同制度

means.en: duties felt as one's own, not as alien commands
means.zh: 义务被视为自己的，而非外来命令

means.en: upbringing as citizenship in a state with good laws
means.zh: 教育即成为良法之邦的公民

summary.en: Ethical life in its immediate form, bound by love; it raises children into independent persons and so dissolves itself.
summary.zh: 伦理的直接形态，以爱为纽带；它把子女培养成独立的人格，从而使自己解体。

explain.en: The family is ethical life as feeling: love, the awareness of my unity with another, so that I am not isolated. Marriage is not a contract. In it two persons freely consent to make themselves one person, an ethical bond based on love and trust, not mere sexual inclination. The family holds property in common, a lasting resource for all its members. Its third moment is raising children, and the aim of upbringing is to make them free, independent persons. So the family prepares its own dissolution: grown children leave and found new families, which meet as independent units in civil society. Hegel's account of the roles of men and women reflects his time and is widely criticised.
explain.zh: 家庭是以感受为形式的伦理：爱，就是意识到我与另一个人的统一，使我不再孤立。婚姻不是契约，而是两个人格自愿同意结合为一个人格，是以爱和信任为基础的伦理纽带，而不只是性的吸引。家庭拥有共同财产，是为全体成员保存的持久资源。第三个环节是教育子女，教育的目的正是让他们成为自由独立的人格。所以家庭在为自己的解体做准备：成年子女离家，建立新的家庭，这些家庭作为独立单位在市民社会中相遇。黑格尔对男女角色的论述带有时代局限，受到广泛批评。

example.en: A couple marry and pool their savings in a joint account: no longer 'mine' and 'yours' but the family's, managed for all. Twenty years later their daughter, raised to think for herself, takes a job in another city, signs her own lease and starts a family. The parents' success shows in her independence, which is also the end of the old household as a unit.
example.zh: 一对夫妻结婚后把积蓄并入共同账户：不再分“我的”“你的”，而是全家的，为所有人打理。二十年后，被培养得有主见的女儿去外地工作、自己签租约、组建家庭。父母成功与否，正体现在她的独立上，而这也意味着原来那个家作为一个单位结束了。

image.en: On top of an open treasure chest sits a big twig nest. Two green lovebirds nestle side by side as if they were one bird, guarding two hatching eggs. A grown fledgling has already hopped down and is bouncing across the floor towards a little house of its own.
image.zh: 一只敞开的宝箱上架着一个大鸟巢。两只绿色的爱情鸟紧紧依偎，像是合成了一只鸟，守着两枚正在破壳的蛋。一只长大的雏鸟已经跳了下来，蹦蹦跳跳地奔向一座属于自己的小房子。

means.en: marriage: two persons consent to become one
means.zh: 婚姻：两个人格自愿合为一体

thing.en: the open chest under the nest

means.en: family property held in common
means.zh: 共同的家庭财产

means.en: children, to be raised into persons
means.zh: 要被培养成人格的子女

thing.en: the fledgling heading for its own house

means.en: the family dissolves into new families
means.zh: 家庭解体为新的家庭

summary.en: Each pursues his own ends yet depends on all: a system of needs with courts, police and corporations, which breeds wealth and poverty together.
summary.zh: 人人追求私利，却又依赖所有人：需要的体系加上司法、警察和同业公会，财富与贫困在其中一同滋长。

explain.en: Hegel was among the first to separate civil society from the state. In it each person is his own end and others are means, yet to meet my needs I must work for others' needs: a system of needs and division of labour, drawn from Smith, Say and Ricardo. Civil society also contains the administration of justice, the 'police' (public authority: market oversight, welfare) and corporations, trade bodies that give members recognition and security. Hegel calls it the battlefield where everyone's private interest meets everyone else's. Left to itself it piles up wealth while producing a rabble: despite an excess of wealth, it is not rich enough to check poverty. It reaches out for markets and colonies, and needs the state above it.
explain.zh: 黑格尔是最早把市民社会与国家区分开的思想家之一。在其中，每个人都以自己为目的，他人只是手段；可要满足自己的需要，我又必须为他人的需要劳动，于是形成需要的体系与分工，这里吸收了斯密、萨伊和李嘉图的学说。市民社会还包括司法、“警察”（公共权力：市场监管与福利）和同业公会，后者给成员以承认和保障。黑格尔称它为人人私利相互冲突的战场。放任自流时，它一边积累财富，一边制造贱民：尽管财富过剩，它却不够富足，无法消除贫困。它向外寻找市场和殖民地，并需要高于它的国家。

example.en: A baker in Berlin sells bread to a tailor, who sews coats for a printer, who prints the baker's price lists. None of them aims at the others' welfare, yet each can live only through the rest. In Hegel's day such booms coexisted with workers sinking below subsistence, losing not only income but the sense of right and honour that comes from supporting oneself by one's own work.
example.zh: 柏林的面包师把面包卖给裁缝，裁缝给印刷商做大衣，印刷商又替面包师印价目表。谁都不以他人的福祉为目的，却谁都只能靠别人活下去。在黑格尔的时代，这样的繁荣与工人跌到温饱线以下同时存在：他们失去的不只是收入，还有靠自己劳动养活自己而来的正义感与尊严。

image.en: A market stall with a striped awning has been set up in the throne room. A merchant and a customer haggle in front of it, each eyeing only his own gain, while gold coins pile up on a crate beside them. On the cold floor a ragged beggar sits holding out an empty cup, and a guild banner stands at the corner.
image.zh: 王座厅里搭起一个条纹遮篷的集市摊位。商人和顾客在摊前讨价还价，各自只盯着自己的好处，旁边的木箱上金币越堆越高。冰冷的地上坐着一个衣衫褴褛的乞丐，伸出一只空杯子；角落里立着一面同业公会的旗帜。

means.en: each his own end, others mere means
means.zh: 人人以己为目的，他人只是手段

means.en: the system of needs and division of labour
means.zh: 需要的体系与分工

thing.zh: 木箱上越堆越高的金币

means.en: wealth accumulating
means.zh: 不断积累的财富

means.en: poverty and the rabble amid excess wealth
means.zh: 财富过剩中的贫困与贱民

means.en: corporations: recognition and security
means.zh: 同业公会：承认与保障

summary.en: 'The actuality of the ethical Idea': the rational state reconciles each person's particular freedom with the universal good.
summary.zh: “伦理理念的现实”：合理的国家让每个人的特殊自由与普遍利益相互和解。

explain.en: The state is 'the actuality of the ethical Idea' and of concrete freedom: particular interests develop fully in civil society, yet citizens knowingly will the universal as their own end. Social-contract theory, Hegel says, confuses the state with civil society, as if it existed only to protect property. His rational state is a constitutional monarchy whose powers (crown, executive, legislature with estates) interlock like an organism. The monarch's role is small: in a well-ordered state he only says 'yes' and dots the i. The line often rendered 'the march of God in the world', from students' notes, says the state's existence is God's way in the world: reason made real, not worship of power. No judge stands above states; hence world history.
explain.zh: 国家是“伦理理念的现实”，也是具体自由的现实：特殊利益在市民社会中充分发展，公民又自觉地把普遍利益当作自己的目的。黑格尔反对社会契约论，认为它把国家混同于市民社会，仿佛国家只为保护财产而存在。他设想的合理国家是君主立宪制，王权、行政权和立法权（含等级会议）像有机体一样相互贯通。君主的作用很小：在组织良好的国家里，他只需说一声“是”，在 i 上点一点。常被译作“神在世上的行进”的那句话出自学生笔记，意思是国家的存在是神在世界中的道路，即理性的实现，而非崇拜强权。国家之上没有法官，这引向世界历史。

example.en: Hegel's own image: in a fully organised state the monarch's decision is formal. Ministers advise, laws bind, and the king merely signs, putting the dot on the i. Compare a modern constitutional monarch giving royal assent to a bill passed by parliament: the act is needed to complete the decision, yet its content comes from elsewhere.
example.zh: 黑格尔自己的比喻：在组织完备的国家里，君主的决定只是形式上的。大臣提出建议，法律具有约束力，国王只需签字，就像给 i 点上那一点。可对照今天的立宪君主对议会通过的法案给予御准：这一步不可缺少，它使决定得以完成，但内容来自别处。

image.en: A gilded throne stands empty at the back of the throne room. The king has stepped down in front of it, crown on his head, and with a giant pencil solemnly dots a huge letter block printed 'i'. That is his whole job. Beside him a crowd of citizens goes about its business, and a scroll on a stand reads 'Constitution'.
image.zh: 王座厅后方立着一张空着的镀金王座。国王从王座上走下来，头戴王冠，手持一支巨大的铅笔，郑重其事地给一块印着“i”的大字块点上那一点：这就是他的全部工作。他身旁，一群市民各忙各的，架子上的卷轴写着“宪法”。

thing.zh: 给 i 点点的国王

means.en: the monarch only completes decisions: says 'yes'
means.zh: 君主只完成决定：说一声“是”

means.en: the crown is one moment of an organic constitution
means.zh: 王权只是有机宪制的一个环节

means.en: citizens free in their pursuits, willing the universal
means.zh: 在各自追求中自由、又意欲普遍的公民

means.en: a rational constitution of interlocking powers
means.zh: 相互贯通的诸权力构成的合理宪制

title.en: National Spirits and the World Spirit

summary.en: Each people embodies one principle for its era; when the principle is spent the world spirit moves on, and world history is the world's court.
summary.zh: 每个民族在自己的时代体现一个原则；原则耗尽，世界精神便继续前行，世界历史就是世界法庭。

explain.en: States face each other with no praetor above them; their disputes and fates are decided in world history. Borrowing a line from Schiller, Hegel says world history is the world's court of judgment (Weltgericht). Each people has a national spirit (Volksgeist), expressed in its religion, law, art, customs and science. In a given epoch one people carries the principle of the world spirit's current stage and is, for that time, dominant. Once its principle has been worked out, it declines and the next principle passes to another people. The world spirit is nothing apart from this succession: it is spirit coming to know itself through it. The scheme is strongly teleological and contested; Hegel insists the verdict is not simply that might is right.
explain.zh: 国家彼此对峙，头上没有裁判官；它们的争端与命运在世界历史中裁决。黑格尔借用席勒的诗句说：世界历史就是世界法庭（Weltgericht）。每个民族都有自己的民族精神（Volksgeist），体现在宗教、法律、艺术、风俗和科学中。在某一时代，一个民族承载世界精神当前阶段的原则，在那个时代居于主导地位。它的原则充分展开之后，这个民族便衰落，下一个原则传给另一个民族。世界精神并不在这种更替之外，它正是借此认识自身的精神。这一图式的目的论色彩很强，向来有争议；黑格尔则强调，这种裁决并不简单等于强权即公理。

example.en: In Hegel's lectures Greece carries the principle of 'beautiful individuality': free citizens at one with their city, as in Pericles' Athens. That harmony could not absorb the reflective, questioning subject that Socrates stood for. After the Peloponnesian War (431–404 BC) and the Macedonian and then Roman conquests, the lead passes to Rome, whose principle is abstract universality and the legal person.
example.zh: 在黑格尔的讲演中，希腊承载“美的个体性”原则：自由的公民与城邦融为一体，如伯里克利时代的雅典。这种和谐容不下苏格拉底所代表的反思、追问的主体。经过伯罗奔尼撒战争（前 431—前 404 年）以及马其顿、罗马的相继征服，主导权传给罗马，其原则是抽象的普遍性与法律人格。

image.en: A steam train stands at the platform, and a glowing ghost, the world spirit, rides on its roof. One flag-bearer, his principle spent, has stepped off and bows out. Another, carrying a new flag, strides up to board. Behind them the tall station clock strikes the hour: judgment time for every nation that has had its turn.
image.zh: 一列蒸汽火车停在站台，车顶上坐着一个发光的幽灵：世界精神。一个旗手的原则已经耗尽，他走下车，鞠躬退场；另一个扛着新旗的人大步走来准备上车。他们身后，高高的站钟敲响：轮到过的每个民族，此刻都要接受审判。

means.en: the world spirit moving through the peoples
means.zh: 穿行于各民族之间的世界精神

means.en: a people whose principle is spent, declining
means.zh: 原则已耗尽、走向衰落的民族

means.en: the next people, carrying a higher principle
means.zh: 承载更高原则的下一个民族

means.en: world history as the world's court of judgment
means.zh: 世界历史即世界法庭

summary.en: Reason lets individuals' passions do its work: great men chase their own ends and unknowingly carry out what their age requires.
summary.zh: 理性让个人的激情替它工作：伟人追逐自己的目的，却在不知不觉中完成时代的需要。

explain.en: History is driven by passions, interests and ambition, and Hegel does not deny it: 'nothing great in the world has been accomplished without passion.' Yet the universal Idea does not throw itself into the struggle. It stays in the background, untouched and unharmed, and sets the passions to work for it; Hegel calls this the cunning of reason. World-historical individuals such as Alexander, Caesar and Napoleon pursue power and glory, but their aims coincide with what their epoch needs. When the work is done they fall away like empty husks. Ordinary people are often sacrificed too: history, Hegel says, is not the theatre of happiness. The idea has a logical twin in teleology, where reason lets objects wear each other out while it preserves itself.
explain.zh: 历史由激情、利益和野心推动，黑格尔并不否认：“没有激情，世界上任何伟大的事业都不会成功。”但普遍的理念并不亲自投入争斗，而是留在幕后，毫发无损，让激情为它工作，黑格尔称之为理性的狡计。亚历山大、恺撒、拿破仑这样的世界历史人物追求权力与荣耀，他们的目的却恰好与时代的需要相合；事业完成，他们便像空壳一样脱落。普通人也常被牺牲：黑格尔说，历史不是幸福的舞台。这个思想在逻辑学的目的论中有一个孪生兄弟：理性让客体彼此消耗，自己却保全下来。

example.en: On 13 October 1806, the eve of the battle of Jena, Hegel saw Napoleon ride out of the town on reconnaissance and wrote to a friend that he had seen the emperor, 'this world-soul', on horseback. Napoleon fought for his own glory, yet his campaigns carried the Civil Code into parts of Germany and swept away feudal privileges there; reason, not the emperor, set the agenda. Napoleon himself ended on St Helena.
example.zh: 1806 年 10 月 13 日，耶拿会战前夕，黑格尔看到拿破仑骑马出城侦察，写信告诉朋友，他看见了皇帝，“这个世界灵魂”，骑在马上。拿破仑为自己的荣耀而战，他的征战却把民法典带进德意志部分地区，扫除了那里的封建特权：定下议程的是理性，而不是皇帝。拿破仑本人最后被流放到圣赫勒拿岛。

image.en: Napoleon gallops across the platform on a white horse, sword raised, flames of passion licking behind the hooves. He thinks he is steering history. On a bench at the back sits the world spirit, a calm glowing ghost, untouched, just watching. In the horse's path lies a fallen soldier with his shield, one of the many used up along the way.
image.zh: 拿破仑骑着白马冲过站台，高举军刀，马蹄后燃着激情的火焰。他以为是自己在驾驭历史。后方的长椅上坐着世界精神，一个安静发光的幽灵，毫发无损，只是看着。马蹄前方倒着一名带盾的士兵，是一路上被消耗掉的众人之一。

means.en: a world-historical individual chasing his own glory
means.zh: 追逐个人荣耀的世界历史人物

means.en: passions: the energy that drives history
means.zh: 激情：推动历史的能量

thing.en: the calm ghost on the bench

means.en: reason stays in the background, unharmed
means.zh: 理性留在幕后，毫发无损

means.en: individuals sacrificed: history is no theatre of happiness
means.zh: 被牺牲的个人：历史不是幸福的舞台

summary.en: World history is the progress of the consciousness of freedom: one is free, then some are free, then all are free as human beings.
summary.zh: 世界历史无非是自由意识的进展：先是一个人自由，再是一些人自由，最后人之为人皆自由。

explain.en: In his Lectures on the Philosophy of World History Hegel claims that world history is nothing but the progress of the consciousness of freedom. In his scheme the Oriental world knew only that one is free, the despot, whose freedom is therefore mere caprice. The Greek and Roman world knew that some are free, for it rested on slavery. The 'Germanic', that is Christian-European, world first grasped that the human being as such is free. The goal is that this freedom be realised in a rational state, not merely believed. Two cautions: the progress is in consciousness and principle, which reality lags behind; and the geography is crudely Eurocentric. Hegel's picture of Asia and his exclusion of Africa from history are widely rejected today.
explain.zh: 黑格尔在《历史哲学讲演录》中说：世界历史无非是自由意识的进展。在他的图式里，东方世界只知道一个人是自由的，即专制君主，而他的自由因此只是任性；希腊和罗马世界知道一些人是自由的，因为它们建立在奴隶制之上；“日耳曼”即基督教欧洲世界才认识到人之为人是自由的。目标是让这种自由在合理的国家中实现，而不只是被信奉。有两点须注意：进展发生在意识和原则上，现实往往滞后；这幅地理图景带有粗糙的欧洲中心论色彩，黑格尔对亚洲的描绘以及把非洲排除在历史之外，今天普遍受到否定。

example.en: Classical Athens had a few tens of thousands of adult male citizens and many slaves: some were free, and only as citizens of that city. Paul's 'there is neither slave nor free' (Galatians 3:28) voices the principle that freedom belongs to humans as such, yet slavery lasted in European colonies into the 19th century. Hegel himself stresses that a principle takes centuries to reshape reality.
example.zh: 古典时代的雅典只有几万名成年男性公民，另有大量奴隶：一些人是自由的，而且只是作为这个城邦的公民才自由。保罗说“并不分自主的、为奴的”（《加拉太书》3:28），表达了人之为人即自由的原则；可欧洲殖民地的奴隶制一直延续到 19 世纪。黑格尔自己也强调，一个原则要用好几个世纪才能改造现实。

image.en: Three groups stand on the platform from left to right. First a lone despot with a crown and a raised sword: one is free. Then two laurelled citizens, with a chained slave kneeling at their feet: some are free. Last a whole crowd cheering, arms up: all are free. A golden arrow on the floor points the way, like a timetable of freedom.
image.zh: 站台上从左到右站着三组人。先是一个头戴王冠、高举宝剑的独裁者：一人自由。接着是两位戴桂冠的公民，脚边跪着一个戴镣铐的奴隶：一些人自由。最后是一整群欢呼的人，双臂高举：所有人自由。地上一支金色箭头指明方向，像一张自由的列车时刻表。

means.en: Hegel's Orient: one is free, and only as caprice
means.zh: 黑格尔笔下的东方：一人自由，且只是任性

means.en: Greece and Rome: some are free, slavery remains
means.zh: 希腊罗马：一些人自由，奴隶制犹存

means.en: Christian Europe: all are free as human beings
means.zh: 基督教欧洲：人之为人皆自由

means.en: history as the progress of the consciousness of freedom
means.zh: 历史即自由意识的进展

title.en: Beauty: The Sensuous Shining of the Idea

summary.en: Art presents the absolute, truth itself, in sensuous form, and beauty made by spirit ranks above the beauty of nature.
summary.zh: 艺术以感性形式呈现绝对即真理本身；由精神创造的美高于自然美。

explain.en: Absolute spirit is spirit knowing itself. Art, religion and philosophy share one content, the absolute, and differ in form: art gives it in sensuous intuition, religion in representation, philosophy in concepts. Art comes first. Hegel defines beauty as the sensuous shining (Scheinen) of the Idea: truth appears in a shape we can see or hear. Artistic beauty ranks above natural beauty because it is 'born of spirit and born again'. Even a silly fancy in someone's head, he says, is higher than any product of nature, since spirit and freedom are in it. So art is not imitation: copying nature only competes with it and loses, like Zeuxis' painted grapes, which fooled only doves. The ideal is a shape fully adequate to its content.
explain.zh: 绝对精神是精神对自身的认识。艺术、宗教、哲学的内容相同，都是绝对，区别在形式：艺术用感性直观，宗教用表象，哲学用概念。艺术是第一阶段。黑格尔把美定义为理念的感性显现（Scheinen）：真理显现为一个看得见、听得到的形象。艺术美高于自然美，因为它是“由心灵产生、又由心灵再生的美”。他甚至说，人脑中一个无聊的念头也比任何自然产物高，因为其中有精神和自由。所以艺术不是模仿：照抄自然只是与自然竞争，而且必输，就像宙克西斯画的葡萄，只骗得过鸽子。理想就是与内容完全相称的形象。

example.en: A sunset may be lovely, but it means nothing and knows nothing. A Rembrandt portrait of an old woman shows a lifetime of patience in the set of her mouth; every brushstroke was chosen by a mind to make that inner life visible. That is why, for Hegel, the painting outranks the sunset, even though only the sunset is 'real'.
example.zh: 日落也许很美，但它什么也不意味，什么也不知道。伦勃朗画的老妇人肖像，在嘴角的线条里显出一辈子的忍耐；每一笔都由一个心灵挑选，为的是让内在生命变得可见。所以在黑格尔看来，画作高于日落，尽管只有日落是“真的”。

image.en: In the gallery a painter in a beret works at a big easel, and a glowing spirit rises from behind the canvas, so the portrait seems lit from inside. A spotlight picks it out. Beside it a real sunflower stands ignored: nature's beauty, outshone by beauty made by spirit.
image.zh: 美术馆里，一位戴贝雷帽的画家在大画架前作画，一个发光的精灵从画布后升起，肖像仿佛从里面被点亮。聚光灯照着它。旁边一株真的向日葵无人理睬：自然美被精神创造的美比了下去。

thing.en: the spirit glowing through the canvas

means.en: the Idea shining in sensuous form
means.zh: 以感性形式显现的理念

means.en: art is born of spirit, not copied from nature
means.zh: 艺术出自精神，而非照抄自然

means.en: natural beauty ranks lower
means.zh: 自然美等级较低

means.en: Scheinen: shining, appearing
means.zh: Scheinen：照耀与显现

title.zh: 象征型、古典型、浪漫型艺术

summary.en: Three relations of meaning and shape: a groping mismatch in symbolic art, a perfect fit in classical art, spirit overflowing form in romantic art.
summary.zh: 意义与形象的三种关系：象征型的摸索与错位，古典型的完美契合，浪漫型的精神溢出形式。

explain.en: Hegel sorts art by how its content, the Idea, relates to its sensuous shape. In symbolic art (ancient Egypt, India, Persia) the meaning is still vague and abstract, so it finds no adequate shape; it reaches for colossal, strange forms that only hint at it. The pyramid, a vast crystal enclosing a hidden dead, is its emblem, and the Sphinx is the symbol of the symbolic itself. In classical art (Greece) content and shape fit perfectly: the god appears as an idealised human body in sculpture. In romantic art (Christian Europe) spirit has become infinite inwardness that no sensuous shape can contain, so art turns to painting, music and poetry. Architecture is the typically symbolic art, sculpture the classical one.
explain.zh: 黑格尔按内容即理念与感性形象的关系划分艺术。象征型艺术（古埃及、印度、波斯）中，意义还模糊抽象，找不到相称的形象，只能借助庞大怪异的形式去暗示。金字塔是它的标志：巨大的晶体，里面藏着逝者；斯芬克斯则是“象征的象征”。古典型艺术（希腊）中内容与形象完美契合：神以理想化的人体出现在雕塑里。浪漫型艺术（基督教欧洲）中，精神已成为无限的内在性，任何感性形象都容纳不下，艺术于是转向绘画、音乐和诗。建筑是典型的象征型艺术，雕塑属古典型。

example.en: The Great Pyramid of Giza, about 146 m tall when built, is an overwhelming mass around a small burial chamber: the meaning is inside, and the shape can only point to it. A Greek statue of Apollo shows divinity entirely in a calm, proportioned body. Bach's St Matthew Passion presents grief and redemption as pure inner movement of sound, with nothing to look at.
example.zh: 吉萨大金字塔建成时高约 146 米，庞大的石块包裹着一间小小的墓室：意义藏在里面，形象只能指向它。一尊希腊阿波罗雕像把神性完全展现在一个宁静匀称的身体上。巴赫的《马太受难曲》把悲痛与救赎呈现为纯粹的声音的内在运动，没有任何东西可看。

image.en: Three works stand in a row under gallery lights. On the left a huge sandstone pyramid squats on the floor, massive and blank, its meaning sealed somewhere inside. In the middle a marble god stands perfect and calm. On the right a glowing spirit floats free above a small painting, as if it had burst out of the frame. A child walks along the row.
image.zh: 美术馆灯光下，三件作品排成一行。左边一座巨大的砂岩金字塔蹲在地上，厚重而空白，意义封在里面某处。中间一尊大理石神像完美而宁静地站着。右边，一个发光的精灵飘浮在一幅小画上方，像是从画框里冲了出来。一个孩子沿着这一排走过。

means.en: symbolic: vague meaning, colossal shape that only hints
means.zh: 象征型：意义模糊，形象庞大，只能暗示

means.en: classical: content and shape in perfect fit
means.zh: 古典型：内容与形象完美契合

means.en: romantic: inwardness overflows every form
means.zh: 浪漫型：内在性溢出一切形式

means.en: the sequence from architecture to sculpture to painting
means.zh: 从建筑到雕塑再到绘画的次序

summary.en: In its highest vocation art is 'a thing of the past': art goes on, but it is no longer the highest way truth comes to us.
summary.zh: 就其最高使命而言，艺术“已是过去的事”：艺术仍在延续，却不再是真理来到我们面前的最高方式。

explain.en: Hegel's thesis: 'art, considered in its highest vocation, is and remains for us a thing of the past.' He does not predict that artists will stop working or that art will decline; he even hopes it will rise and perfect itself. His claim is that for the modern mind a sensuous shape is no longer the supreme way to grasp truth. However perfect the statues of Greek gods or the images of Christ and Mary, 'we bow the knee no longer'. We now need a science of art: we reflect on works and judge them instead of worshipping through them. Romantic art had already shown that spirit's inwardness exceeds every sensuous form, so the absolute is grasped more inwardly, in religious devotion and then in philosophical concepts. How far the thesis holds is still debated.
explain.zh: 黑格尔的论断是：“就它的最高使命来说，艺术对于我们已是并且永远是过去的事了。”他并不预言艺术家会停工或艺术会衰落，甚至希望艺术继续提高和完善。他的意思是：对现代心灵而言，感性形象已不再是把握真理的最高方式。希腊神像再完美，基督和圣母的形象再出色，“我们也不再屈膝膜拜了”。我们需要的是艺术哲学：对作品进行反思和评判，而不是借它们来敬拜。浪漫型艺术早已表明精神的内在性超出一切感性形式，于是绝对要以更内在的方式来把握：先在宗教的虔敬中，再在哲学的概念中。这一论断成立到什么程度，至今仍有争论。

example.en: In the Louvre, crowds photograph the Winged Victory of Samothrace. Some read the wall label, some check the date (around 190 BC), many queue for a selfie; nobody leaves an offering at her feet. Art thrives as an object of enjoyment and study, which is exactly Hegel's point: its works are admired and discussed, not worshipped.
example.zh: 卢浮宫里，人群围着萨莫色雷斯的胜利女神像拍照。有人读墙上的说明，有人看年代（约公元前 190 年），很多人排队自拍，却没有人在她脚下献上供品。艺术作为欣赏和研究的对象依然繁荣，这正是黑格尔的意思：作品被欣赏、被讨论，却不再被敬拜。

image.en: A gilded statue of a god stands under a gallery spotlight, magnificent. In front of it is a church pew, but the visitor on it sits with his back to the god, reading a guidebook about it. Another visitor snaps a photo, and a third strolls past, peering at the god through a magnifying glass. Admired, studied, photographed: no one bows the knee.
image.zh: 聚光灯下立着一尊镀金神像，金碧辉煌。像前摆着一条教堂长凳，坐在上面的参观者却背对神像，埋头读着介绍它的导览手册。另一位参观者举起相机拍照，第三位拿着放大镜边走边打量神像。被欣赏、被研究、被拍照：却没有人屈膝。

thing.en: the gilded god in the spotlight

means.en: art at its height, still beautiful
means.zh: 依然美丽的巅峰艺术

means.en: reflection has replaced devotion
means.zh: 反思取代了虔敬

means.en: we enjoy, study and judge art
means.zh: 我们欣赏、研究、评判艺术

means.en: art is no longer truth's highest form
means.zh: 艺术不再是真理的最高形式

summary.en: Religion has the same content as philosophy, the absolute, but holds it in representation: images, stories, feeling and worship.
summary.zh: 宗教与哲学内容相同，都是绝对，但它以表象来把握：图像、故事、情感与礼拜。

explain.en: Religion is the second shape of absolute spirit. Its content is the same as philosophy's, the absolute truth, God; the difference lies in form. Religion uses representation (Vorstellung): it turns the moments of the concept into images and narratives, sets them side by side in space and one after another in time ('the Father begets the Son', 'God created the world'), and joins the believer to the absolute through faith, devotion and the cult. It is the way truth exists for everyone, not only for philosophers. Religion also has a history: from nature religions through the Greek religion of art to Christianity, which Hegel calls the revealed or consummate religion, because in it God is known as spirit.
explain.zh: 宗教是绝对精神的第二种形态。它的内容与哲学相同，都是绝对真理即上帝，区别在形式。宗教用表象（Vorstellung）：把概念的各个环节变成图像和叙事，在空间中并列，在时间中先后排开（“圣父生圣子”“上帝创造世界”），并借信仰、虔敬与礼拜让信徒与绝对合一。这是真理为所有人存在的方式，而不只为哲学家。宗教也有自己的历史：从自然宗教，经希腊的艺术宗教，到基督教；黑格尔称基督教为天启宗教或完满的宗教，因为在其中上帝被认识为精神。

example.en: 'God created the world in six days' is a picture: it sets creation in time, as an event that happened once. Hegel's conceptual reading is that the world is not self-standing but depends on the absolute, whose nature is to go out of itself into an other. Same content, different form: the believer pictures it with feeling, the philosopher thinks why it must be so.
example.zh: “上帝在六日内创造了世界”是一幅图景：它把创造放进时间，当作曾经发生过一次的事件。黑格尔的概念式解读是：世界不是自立的，而是依赖于绝对，而绝对的本性就是走出自身、进入他者。内容相同，形式不同：信徒带着情感去想象它，哲学家则思考它为何必然如此。

image.en: A tall stained-glass window glows in the cathedral, and a spotlight pours a white beam into it. What comes through is no longer plain light but coloured pictures of stories. A woman kneels before the window holding a candle, praying, and a child beside her points up at a figure in the glass, wide-eyed.
image.zh: 大教堂里一扇高高的彩色玻璃窗在发光，聚光灯把一束白光打进去。透出来的不再是纯白的光，而是一幅幅彩色的故事画面。一位妇女举着蜡烛跪在窗前祈祷，身边的孩子睁大眼睛，指着玻璃上的一个人物。

means.en: the one absolute content, the truth
means.zh: 唯一的绝对内容：真理

means.en: representation: images and narratives
means.zh: 表象：图像与叙事

thing.en: the kneeling woman with a candle

means.en: faith, devotion and worship
means.zh: 信仰、虔敬与礼拜

means.en: truth in a form open to everyone
means.zh: 人人都能接近的真理形式

summary.en: Christianity knows God as spirit: the Trinity pictures the concept's three moments, and death and resurrection picture the negation of the negation.
summary.zh: 在基督教中上帝被认识为精神：三位一体描绘概念的三个环节，死亡与复活描绘否定之否定。

explain.en: For Hegel, Christianity is the revealed, consummate religion: in it God is revealed as spirit. He reads the Trinity as the concept's structure in pictorial form. The Father is the universal, God in himself, like the logical Idea. The Son is particularity: God going out into finitude, in creation and incarnation. The Spirit is the individual return: God present in the believing community. Christ's death is the deepest negation; Hegel cites the Lutheran hymn line 'God himself is dead'. The resurrection is the death of death, the negation of the negation. The reconciliation of finite and infinite that the unhappy consciousness sought in a beyond is reached here, if only in pictures. Whether this reading is orthodox is debated.
explain.zh: 黑格尔称基督教为天启宗教或完满的宗教，因为在其中上帝作为精神启示了自己。他把三位一体读作以表象形式出现的概念结构：圣父是普遍，即自在的上帝，相当于逻辑理念；圣子是特殊，即上帝走入有限，表现为创世与道成肉身；圣灵是个别的回归，即上帝临在于信徒的团契之中。基督之死是最深的否定，黑格尔引用路德派赞美诗的句子“上帝自己死了”；复活则是死亡之死，即否定之否定。苦恼意识在彼岸寻求的有限与无限的和解，在这里实现了，尽管仍以表象的方式。这究竟是正统基督教，还是把它译成了哲学，至今仍有争论。

example.en: Map the creed onto the concept. 'I believe in God, the Father almighty' is the universal. 'And in Jesus Christ, his only Son ... crucified, died and was buried' is the particular: God as one finite human who dies. 'On the third day he rose again' and 'I believe in the Holy Spirit ... the communion of saints' are the individual: spirit alive in a community. Three moments, one God.
example.zh: 把信经与概念对照：“我信上帝，全能的父”是普遍；“我信我主耶稣基督，上帝的独生子……被钉于十字架，受死，埋葬”是特殊，即上帝成为一个会死的有限的人；“第三天从死人中复活”与“我信圣灵……我信圣徒相通”是个别，即活在团契中的精神。三个环节，一个上帝。

image.en: High above the nave hangs a blazing sun. Below it a robed figure lies stretched out on the stone floor, still. A white dove has risen from him and hovers over a small crowd of believers, who look up as one. Light above, death below, and life spreading out among the people.
image.zh: 中殿高处悬着一轮炽亮的太阳。它下方，一个穿长袍的人静静地躺在石地上。一只白鸽已从他身上飞起，盘旋在一小群信徒头顶，众人一齐抬头仰望。上有光，下有死亡，而生命正在人群中扩散开来。

means.en: the Father: the universal, God in himself
means.zh: 圣父：普遍，自在的上帝

means.en: the Son: God made finite, and his death
means.zh: 圣子：成为有限的上帝及其死亡

means.en: the Spirit: God alive in the community
means.zh: 圣灵：活在团契中的上帝

thing.en: from the dead figure to the rising dove

means.en: resurrection as the negation of the negation
means.zh: 复活即否定之否定

summary.en: Philosophy translates religion's pictures into concepts: it keeps the content, lifts the form, and so comprehends why the faith is true.
summary.zh: 哲学把宗教的图像译成概念：保留内容、提升形式，从而理解信仰为何是真的。

explain.en: Religion already has the truth, but in a defective form. Representation sets the moments of the concept side by side and in sequence, as events of a sacred history that happened once or will happen at the end of time. Reconciliation is felt in the believer's heart yet pushed into a beyond: a past event, a future kingdom. Philosophy does not refute religion or swap its content. It translates the same content from representation into concept, showing why it must be so, and grasps reconciliation as actual here and now. Hegel can therefore call philosophy itself a kind of worship. This is sublation at work: the content kept, the pictorial form cancelled, the whole lifted into thought. Critics on both sides doubted that nothing is lost in translation.
explain.zh: 宗教已经拥有真理，但形式有缺陷。表象把概念的各环节并列、排序，变成一部神圣历史中的事件：要么发生在过去，要么发生在末日。和解在信徒心中被感受到，却被推到彼岸：一件过去的事，一个未来的国度。哲学不是要驳倒宗教，也不是替换它的内容，而是把同一内容从表象译成概念，说明它为何必然如此，并把和解理解为此时此地的现实。所以黑格尔可以说，哲学本身也是一种礼拜。这正是扬弃：内容被保存，图像形式被取消，整体被提升到思想。至于翻译中是否毫无损失，左右两派的批评者都有怀疑。

example.en: Picture: 'The Son of God became man, died and rose again.' Concept: the infinite is not a beyond set against the finite; it is the movement of going out into the finite and returning to itself through negation, the true infinite of the Logic. The believer holds this as a story about one man in Palestine; the philosopher sees in it the structure of all spirit, ours included.
example.zh: 表象：“上帝之子成为人，受死，又复活。”概念：无限不是与有限对立的彼岸，而是走进有限、又通过否定回到自身的运动，即逻辑学中的真无限。信徒把它当作巴勒斯坦一个人的故事来持守；哲学家则从中看到一切精神的结构，包括我们自己。

image.en: In the middle of the cathedral a conveyor belt hums. At its left end a stained-glass panel waits beside a funnel that feeds the belt; at the right end out comes an open book printed 'Concept'. Behind the belt a robed philosopher with a magnifying glass checks that the colours on the page match those in the glass: content kept, form transformed.
image.zh: 大教堂中央，一条传送带嗡嗡运转。左端，一块彩色玻璃窗板等在给传送带进料的漏斗旁；右端出来的是一本摊开的书，上面印着“概念”。传送带后面，一位穿长袍的哲学家拿着放大镜核对：书页上的颜色与玻璃上的一模一样。内容保留了，形式改变了。

thing.en: the stained glass by the funnel

means.en: religion's pictures going in
means.zh: 送进去的宗教图像

means.en: the same content in conceptual form
means.zh: 以概念形式呈现的同一内容

means.en: nothing of the content is discarded
means.zh: 内容一点也没有丢弃

means.en: translation as sublation: cancel, keep, lift
means.zh: 翻译即扬弃：取消、保存、提升

title.en: The History of Philosophy Is Philosophy

summary.en: The sequence of philosophical systems is one philosophy developing; each system is refuted only as final and survives as a moment.
summary.zh: 哲学体系的更替是同一个哲学的发展；每个体系被驳倒的只是它的终极地位，它本身作为环节保留下来。

explain.en: Hegel rejects the view of the history of philosophy as a gallery of opinions refuting one another. It is one philosophy developing in time, and the order of systems roughly matches the order of the logical categories: Parmenides grasped being, Heraclitus becoming ('there is no proposition of Heraclitus which I have not adopted in my Logic'), the atomists being-for-self, Spinoza substance. No principle is simply refuted; what is refuted is its claim to be the whole, final truth. It is demoted to a moment of a richer whole. So the latest philosophy, if genuine, is the result of all earlier ones and must contain their principles. This is determinate negation applied to the history of thought, and makes reading old philosophers a way of doing philosophy.
explain.zh: 黑格尔反对把哲学史看作一座陈列互相驳斥的意见的画廊。哲学史是同一个哲学在时间中的发展，诸体系的次序大致对应逻辑范畴的次序：巴门尼德把握了存在，赫拉克利特把握了变易（“赫拉克利特的命题，没有一个我没有纳入我的逻辑学”），原子论者把握了自为存在，斯宾诺莎把握了实体。没有哪个原则被简单驳倒，被驳倒的只是它自称为全部和最终真理的要求；它被降为一个更丰富整体中的环节。所以最新的哲学，只要是真正的哲学，就是此前一切哲学的成果，必须包含它们的原则。这是确定的否定在思想史上的运用，也使研读古代哲学家本身成为在做哲学。

example.en: Parmenides (around 500 BC): only being is, and change is illusion. Heraclitus: everything flows. Refuting Parmenides does not throw being away: the Logic still opens with pure being and shows how it passes into nothing and becoming. Spinoza's single substance, 'God or nature', is likewise kept, but Hegel adds that substance must also be grasped as subject.
example.zh: 巴门尼德（约公元前 500 年）：唯有存在，变化只是幻象。赫拉克利特：万物皆流。驳倒巴门尼德并不等于扔掉存在：逻辑学依然以纯存在开篇，并说明它如何过渡为无和变易。斯宾诺莎“神即自然”的唯一实体同样被保留，只是黑格尔补充说：实体也必须被理解为主体。

image.en: In the temple four marble busts of philosophers stand stacked, each on the head of the one before, a wobbly column taller than a person. Parmenides is at the bottom, named on a little plaque. A young critic swings a hammer at him and a crack runs through the marble, yet the bust holds and keeps carrying all the others: refuted, but still bearing the weight.
image.zh: 神庙里，四尊哲学家的大理石半身像一个顶着一个摞起来，摇摇晃晃，比人还高。最底下是巴门尼德，小牌子上写着他的名字。一个年轻的批评者抡起锤子砸向他，大理石裂开一道缝，可这尊像依然稳住，继续托着上面所有的人：被驳倒了，却仍在承重。

means.en: systems in sequence, each built on its predecessors
means.zh: 依次相承、层层叠加的诸体系

means.en: being: the first principle, still carrying the rest
means.zh: 存在：最初的原则，仍承载其余

means.en: refuted as final truth, kept as a moment
means.zh: 作为终极真理被驳倒，作为环节被保留

means.en: each new system refutes and inherits
means.zh: 每个新体系都在驳斥中继承

summary.en: Philosophy is its own time comprehended in thought; it always comes too late to instruct the world how it ought to be.
summary.zh: 哲学是被把握在思想中的它的时代；要教导世界应当如何，它总是来得太迟。

explain.en: The Preface to the Philosophy of Right calls philosophy 'its own time comprehended in thoughts', so it can no more leap beyond its age than a person can jump over Rhodes. Its task is to recognise reason in what is actual, not to design an ideal state in a beyond. As for teaching the world how it ought to be, philosophy always comes too late: it appears only when actuality has completed its process of formation. 'When philosophy paints its grey in grey, a shape of life has grown old... The owl of Minerva begins its flight only with the falling of dusk.' Minerva is the Roman goddess of wisdom, and the owl is her bird. The point is retrospective comprehension; whether it leaves room for criticising the present is debated.
explain.zh: 《法哲学原理》序言说，哲学是“被把握在思想中的它的时代”，所以它跳不出自己的时代，正如一个人跳不过罗陀斯岛。它的任务是在现实中认出理性，而不是在彼岸设计一个理想国家。至于教导世界应当如何，哲学总是来得太迟：只有当现实完成了它的形成过程，哲学才出现。“当哲学把它的灰色绘成灰色时，一种生活形态就已经变老了……密涅瓦的猫头鹰要等黄昏到来才会起飞。”密涅瓦是罗马的智慧女神，猫头鹰是她的鸟。要点是回顾性的理解；它是否还给批判现实留有余地，则有争论。

example.en: The Philosophy of Right appeared in late 1820 (dated 1821), after the French Revolution, the Napoleonic wars and the Prussian reforms had already reshaped Europe. It does not tell Prussia what to do next; it tries to understand the modern state that had emerged. By the time the system of modern freedom could be written down, that shape of life was already mature.
example.zh: 《法哲学原理》于 1820 年底出版（扉页印 1821 年），那时法国大革命、拿破仑战争和普鲁士改革早已重塑了欧洲。这本书并不告诉普鲁士下一步该做什么，而是试图理解已经形成的现代国家。等到现代自由的体系能被写下来时，那种生活形态已经成熟。

image.en: Dusk in the temple: a crescent moon has risen and a lamp post flickers on. Only now does a great owl lift off from beside the head of Minerva's marble statue and sweep over the stage. Below, a philosopher at an easel paints a canvas entirely grey: the day is done, and now it can be understood.
image.zh: 神庙里已是黄昏：一弯新月升起，路灯闪亮起来。直到此刻，一只大猫头鹰才从密涅瓦大理石像的头边起飞，掠过舞台。下方，一位哲学家在画架前把整块画布涂成灰色：白天已经结束，现在才能被理解。

thing.en: the owl taking off at dusk

means.en: philosophy arrives when an era has matured
means.zh: 哲学在一个时代成熟后才到来

thing.en: the moon and the lit lamp

means.en: dusk: a shape of life has grown old
means.zh: 黄昏：一种生活形态已经变老

means.en: grey in grey: comprehension, not rejuvenation
means.zh: 灰色绘成灰色：理解而非返老还童

means.en: wisdom: its own time comprehended in thought
means.zh: 智慧：被把握在思想中的时代

summary.en: The system is a circle whose end returns to its beginning; each of its parts, logic, nature and spirit, is a circle too.
summary.zh: 体系是一个终点回到起点的圆圈；逻辑、自然、精神每一部分本身也是一个圆圈。

explain.en: Hegel calls philosophy a circle: each part is a whole rounded in itself, and the whole is 'a circle of circles' (Encyclopedia §15; the Science of Logic says the same of its method). The system starts from pure being, the emptiest thought, with nothing presupposed. It ends with absolute spirit thinking itself, which turns out to be what was implicitly there from the start. So the end leads back to the beginning, now fully developed. The Encyclopedia closes with three syllogisms in which logic, nature and spirit take turns as the middle term, and then with Aristotle's words on thought thinking itself. This is Hegel's answer to the problem of a first principle: the beginning is justified only at the end, as a result.
explain.zh: 黑格尔把哲学称为一个圆圈：每一部分都是自身完满的整体，而整体是“圆圈之圆圈”（《哲学全书》§15；《逻辑学》论方法时也这样说）。体系从纯存在这一最空洞、无前提的思想开始，终于思维自身的绝对精神，而这正是从一开始就潜在地存在的东西。终点于是回到起点，只是起点已被充分展开。《哲学全书》以三个推理收尾，逻辑、自然、精神轮流充当中项，最后引用亚里士多德论“思想思维自身”的话。这就是黑格尔对第一原理问题的回答：开端只有在终点处，作为结果，才得到证明。

example.en: Walk the palace: you began with sense-certainty and pure being, climbed through essence and concept, crossed nature, and reached spirit and philosophy. Philosophy's last insight is that the whole climb was thought developing itself, which sends you back to the first room, pure being; but now you know what it was the beginning of. As on a spiral ramp, you stand where you began, one turn higher.
example.zh: 走一遍这座宫殿：你从感性确定性和纯存在出发，穿过本质与概念，越过自然，到达精神与哲学。哲学最后领悟到，整段攀登就是思想自身的展开，于是把你送回第一间展厅，回到纯存在；只是这一次，你知道它是什么的开端了。就像走螺旋坡道，你站回起点，却高了一圈。

image.en: Three huge wagon wheels, gold, green and blue, stand in a ring on the temple floor: logic, nature, spirit. Curved golden arrows on the floor lead from each wheel to the next and from the last back to the first. In the middle a traveller with a lantern completes the round and turns back towards the gold wheel where she set out.
image.zh: 神庙地上，三只巨大的车轮站成一圈，金、绿、蓝三色：逻辑、自然、精神。地上弯曲的金色箭头从一个车轮指向下一个，再从最后一个指回第一个。中间一位提灯的旅人走完一圈，又转身走向她出发时的金色车轮。

means.en: logic, nature, spirit: each a circle
means.zh: 逻辑、自然、精神：各是一个圆圈

means.en: the whole: a circle of circles
means.zh: 整体：圆圈之圆圈

thing.en: arrows leading back to the start

means.en: the end returns to the beginning
means.zh: 终点回到起点

means.en: the beginning, now understood as a result
means.zh: 开端如今作为结果被理解

summary.en: A user story says who wants what and why; acceptance criteria turn it into something you can test.
summary.zh: 用户故事说明谁想要什么、为什么；验收标准让它变得可以测试。

explain.en: A user story is a short requirement told from the user's side: 'As a <role>, I want <capability>, so that <benefit>.' It is a placeholder for a conversation, not a full specification. Acceptance criteria state when the story is done, often as Given/When/Then scenarios, so developers, testers and the product owner agree on 'done' and can automate the checks. Good stories are small and sliced vertically: each one cuts through UI, API and database to deliver a thin piece of working value, rather than a horizontal layer such as 'build all the tables first'. INVEST (independent, negotiable, valuable, estimable, small, testable) is a common checklist.
explain.zh: 用户故事从用户的角度描述需求：“作为<角色>，我想要<功能>，以便<收益>”。它是一次对话的占位符，而不是完整的规格说明。验收标准（acceptance criteria）写明故事何时算完成，常用 Given/When/Then 场景表达，让开发、测试和产品对“完成”达成一致，并能写成自动化检查。好的故事要小，并且纵向切分：每个故事贯穿界面、API 和数据库，交付一小块能用的价值，而不是“先把所有表建好”这样的横向分层。INVEST（独立、可协商、有价值、可估算、小、可测试）是常用的检查清单。

example.en: Story: As a shopper, I want my cart saved, so that I can finish buying on another device. Criteria: Given a signed-in shopper with 3 items in the cart, when she signs in on her phone, then the same 3 items appear. Given a guest, when the browser closes, then the cart is kept for 7 days. First vertical slice: save and restore the cart for signed-in shoppers only.
example.zh: 故事：作为购物者，我想保存购物车，以便在另一台设备上继续购买。验收标准：假设已登录用户的购物车里有 3 件商品，当她在手机上登录时，那么看到同样的 3 件商品；假设是游客，当浏览器关闭时，那么购物车保留 7 天。第一个纵向切片：只为已登录用户保存并恢复购物车。

image.en: A giant pink cake fills the classroom, already cut into wedges that each run from the icing down to the base. A child holds up a scroll with her wish. The teacher, in a chef's hat, points at the blackboard, where Given, When and Then are chalked one under another, and a big green stamp waits beside the cake to mark a slice as done.
image.zh: 一个巨大的粉色蛋糕占满了教室，已经切成一块块从奶油顶一直切到底的楔形。一个孩子举着写有心愿的卷轴。戴厨师帽的老师指着黑板，上面一行行写着 Given、When、Then；蛋糕旁一枚绿色大印章，等着给做好的那块盖“完成”。

means.en: As a … I want … so that …: the story
means.zh: “作为…我想要…以便…”：故事本身

thing.en: Given / When / Then on the board

means.en: acceptance criteria that make the story testable
means.zh: 让故事可测试的验收标准

means.en: vertical slices: each one goes through UI, API and data
means.zh: 纵向切片：每块都贯穿界面、API 和数据

means.en: done only when every criterion passes
means.zh: 所有标准都通过才算完成

summary.en: Quality targets such as latency, availability, scalability, security and cost, stated as numbers you can measure.
summary.zh: 延迟、可用性、可扩展性、安全和成本等质量目标，要写成可度量的数字。

explain.en: Functional requirements say what the system does; non-functional requirements (quality attributes) say how well it must do it: latency, throughput, availability, scalability, durability, security, cost and maintainability. They shape the architecture more than most features do, and they are useless when vague. 'Fast' and 'highly available' cannot be tested; 'p99 latency under 200 ms at 1,000 requests per second' and '99.9% monthly availability' can. Use percentiles rather than averages, because a few slow requests hide inside a mean. Quality attributes pull against each other (stronger consistency or encryption can cost latency and money), so rank them with the stakeholders.
explain.zh: 功能需求说明系统做什么；非功能需求（质量属性）说明要做到多好：延迟、吞吐量、可用性、可扩展性、持久性、安全、成本和可维护性。它们对架构的影响往往大于具体功能，而且一旦含糊就毫无用处。“要快”“高可用”无法测试；“每秒 1000 个请求时 p99 延迟低于 200 毫秒”“月可用性 99.9%”才能测试。要用百分位数而不是平均值，因为少数慢请求会被均值掩盖。各项质量属性相互牵制（更强的一致性或加密可能增加延迟和成本），需要与干系人一起排出优先级。

example.en: 99.9% availability allows 0.001 × 30 days × 24 h × 60 min ≈ 43 minutes of downtime a month; 99.99% allows about 4.3 minutes. If 98 of 100 requests take 50 ms and 2 take 2 s, the mean is 89 ms and looks fine, but the p99 is 2 s.
example.zh: 99.9% 可用性允许每月停机 0.001 × 30 天 × 24 小时 × 60 分钟 ≈ 43 分钟；99.99% 只允许约 4.3 分钟。100 个请求中 98 个各耗时 50 毫秒、2 个耗时 2 秒，平均值是 89 毫秒，看起来不错，但 p99 是 2 秒。

image.en: A giant ruler on a stand runs from 0 to 300 ms across the classroom. Four white rabbits sit near its start, but one huge turtle plods along far past the 200 mark. The teacher clicks her stopwatch and points at the turtle, while a small sign beside the rabbits demands 99.9%.
image.zh: 一把立着的巨大标尺横跨教室，从 0 标到 300 毫秒。四只白兔蹲在起点附近，一只巨龟却慢吞吞地爬过了 200 的刻度。老师按下秒表，指着那只乌龟；兔子旁边的小牌子写着 99.9%。

means.en: most requests are fast, so the mean looks fine
means.zh: 大多数请求很快，均值看着不错

means.en: the slow tail that p99 exposes and a mean hides
means.zh: p99 暴露、均值掩盖的慢尾

means.en: measure: a requirement must be a testable number
means.zh: 去测量：需求必须是可测的数字

means.en: an availability target: about 43 minutes down a month
means.zh: 可用性目标：每月约 43 分钟停机

summary.en: Model the business in its own words: entities, value objects and aggregates inside bounded contexts that share one ubiquitous language.
summary.zh: 用业务自己的语言建模：在限界上下文中划分实体、值对象和聚合，并使用统一语言。

explain.en: Domain-driven design (DDD) shapes code around the business domain. An entity has an identity that lasts while its attributes change (customer 42). A value object is defined only by its values and is usually immutable (Money(10, 'EUR'), an address). An aggregate is a cluster of objects changed together through one root that enforces their invariants; outside code holds references only to the root, and one transaction usually changes one aggregate. A bounded context is the boundary inside which a model and its words have a single meaning: 'account' in billing need not match 'account' in login. Within it, developers and domain experts share a ubiquitous language, used both in conversation and in code.
explain.zh: 领域驱动设计（DDD）让代码围绕业务领域来组织。实体（entity）有贯穿始终的身份，属性可以变化（42 号客户）。值对象（value object）只由取值决定，通常不可变（Money(10, 'EUR')、地址）。聚合（aggregate）是一组必须一起修改的对象，由聚合根统一维护不变量；外部只引用聚合根，一个事务通常只改一个聚合。限界上下文（bounded context）是模型及其术语保持单一含义的边界：计费里的“账户”不必等同于登录里的“账户”。在边界内，开发者和领域专家使用同一套统一语言（ubiquitous language），对话和代码都用它。

example.en: An Order aggregate has the root Order (an entity, id 1001) and its OrderLines. Rule: the total may not exceed the customer's credit limit, so lines are added only through order.add_line(sku, qty), never by editing a line directly. Price is a value object: two Money(9.99, 'USD') values are interchangeable. In the Shipping context the same order is just a Parcel with a weight and an address.
example.zh: 订单聚合以 Order（实体，id 1001）为根，内含若干 OrderLine。规则：总额不得超过客户的信用额度，因此只能通过 order.add_line(sku, qty) 添加明细，不能直接改某一行。价格是值对象：两个 Money(9.99, 'USD') 可以互换。在物流上下文里，同一个订单只是一个带重量和地址的包裹（Parcel）。

image.en: Inside a curved wooden fence, a stern owl broods on a big nest, with three eggs peeking out in front of it: anyone who wants an egg has to deal with the owl. A green parrot perched on the fence squawks 'Order!', and the farmer and the programmer standing in front both point at it and repeat the very same word.
image.zh: 一圈弧形木栅栏里，一只神情严肃的猫头鹰趴在大鸟巢上，三枚蛋从它身前露出来：谁想拿蛋，都得先过猫头鹰这一关。栅栏上的绿鹦鹉大叫“订单！”，站在前面的农夫和程序员都指着它，重复着同一个词。

means.en: a bounded context: one model, one meaning per word
means.zh: 限界上下文：一个模型，词义唯一

means.en: the aggregate root: every change goes through it and it guards the rules
means.zh: 聚合根：一切修改都经过它，由它守护规则

means.en: objects inside the aggregate, changed together in one transaction
means.zh: 聚合内的对象，在一个事务里一起修改

means.en: the ubiquitous language shared by experts and code
means.zh: 专家和代码共用的统一语言

summary.en: Name things with noun URLs, act on them with HTTP methods, exchange representations, and keep every request self-contained.
summary.zh: 用名词 URL 命名资源，用 HTTP 方法操作，交换资源的表述，并让每个请求自带全部信息。

explain.en: REST (Representational State Transfer, Roy Fielding, 2000) is an architectural style. In everyday HTTP APIs it means: each thing of interest is a resource named by a URL built from nouns (/orders/42/items), and the standard methods act on it: GET reads, POST creates or triggers processing, PUT replaces, PATCH partly updates, DELETE removes. Clients exchange representations of a resource (usually JSON), not the resource itself. Requests are stateless: each carries everything the server needs, such as an auth token, so any instance can serve it and the service scales out. GET, PUT and DELETE are idempotent; POST in general is not. Many 'REST' APIs omit the hypermedia links Fielding's definition requires.
explain.zh: REST（表述性状态转移，Roy Fielding 于 2000 年提出）是一种架构风格。在日常的 HTTP API 里，它的意思是：每个被关注的对象都是资源，用名词构成的 URL 命名（/orders/42/items），再用标准方法操作：GET 读取，POST 创建或触发处理，PUT 整体替换，PATCH 部分更新，DELETE 删除。客户端交换的是资源的表述（通常是 JSON），而不是资源本身。请求无状态：每个请求自带服务器所需的一切（例如认证令牌），任何实例都能处理，服务便于水平扩展。GET、PUT、DELETE 是幂等的，POST 一般不是。很多所谓的 REST API 省略了 Fielding 定义中必需的超媒体链接。

example.en: GET /orders/42 returns {"id": 42, "status": "paid"}. PATCH /orders/42 with {"status": "cancelled"} changes one field. POST /orders/42/refunds creates a refund and returns 201 with Location: /orders/42/refunds/7. Avoid verbs in paths, such as POST /cancelOrder?id=42.
example.zh: GET /orders/42 返回 {"id": 42, "status": "paid"}。PATCH /orders/42 携带 {"status": "cancelled"}，只改一个字段。POST /orders/42/refunds 创建一笔退款，返回 201 和 Location: /orders/42/refunds/7。避免把动词写进路径，比如 POST /cancelOrder?id=42。

image.en: A giant envelope addressed '/orders/42' stands at the post-office counter, and a big rubber stamp beside it decides what will happen to it: read, replace or delete. Above the counter floats a goldfish clerk who forgets every customer the moment they turn away, so the next customer arrives holding an envelope that carries everything needed, token included.
image.zh: 邮局柜台前立着一个巨大的信封，地址写着“/orders/42”，旁边一枚大橡皮图章决定怎么处理它：读取、替换还是删除。柜台上方漂着一条金鱼职员，客人一转身它就忘得一干二净，所以下一位客人递来的信封里自带一切所需，连令牌也在里面。

means.en: a resource named by a noun URL
means.zh: 用名词 URL 命名的资源

means.en: the HTTP method says the action: GET, POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE
means.zh: HTTP 方法表示动作：GET、POST、PUT、PATCH、DELETE

means.en: a stateless server keeps no session between requests
means.zh: 无状态服务器不在请求之间保存会话

means.en: each request carries its own token and context
means.zh: 每个请求自带令牌和上下文

summary.en: The status code tells the client what happened and whether retrying can help; a consistent error body says why.
summary.zh: 状态码告诉客户端发生了什么、重试是否有用；统一的错误体说明原因。

explain.en: 2xx means success (200 OK, 201 Created, 204 No Content). 4xx means the client must change something: 400 malformed, 401 not authenticated, 403 authenticated but not allowed, 404 not found, 409 conflicts with the current state (a duplicate, a stale version), 422 well-formed but invalid (many APIs use 400 for both), 429 too many requests. 5xx means the server failed: 500 a bug, 502 or 504 a failing or slow upstream, 503 temporarily unavailable. Resending an unchanged 4xx request usually fails again; 429 is retried after waiting. 5xx errors and timeouts may be retried with backoff, but only for idempotent operations. Return one error shape everywhere, such as {code, message, details}.
explain.zh: 2xx 表示成功（200 OK、201 Created、204 No Content）。4xx 表示客户端得改点什么：400 格式错误，401 未认证，403 已认证但无权限，404 不存在，409 与当前状态冲突（重复创建、版本过期），422 格式正确但校验失败（不少 API 都用 400），429 请求过多。5xx 表示服务器出错：500 程序缺陷，502/504 上游故障或超时，503 暂时不可用。原样重发 4xx 请求通常还会失败，429 等一等再试除外；5xx 和超时可以带退避重试，但仅限幂等操作。所有接口返回同一种错误结构，例如 {code, message, details}。

example.en: POST /users with broken JSON: 400. Valid JSON but a bad email: 422 {"code": "invalid_email", "message": "email must contain @"}. Email already registered: 409. User database down: 503 with Retry-After: 30. The client may retry that 503 safely only if the POST carries an idempotency key; retrying the 422 unchanged is pointless.
example.zh: POST /users 的 JSON 写坏了：400。JSON 合法但邮箱非法：422 {"code": "invalid_email", "message": "email must contain @"}。邮箱已注册：409。用户数据库宕机：503，并带 Retry-After: 30。只有 POST 带了幂等键，客户端才能放心重试这个 503；原样重试 422 毫无意义。

image.en: In the sorting room a robot arm drops every reply into one of three baskets: green for delivered, orange for 'return to sender', red for 'our fault'. The red basket is on fire. A customer shrugs at the orange letter handed back to her, while a clerk holding a stopwatch tells the next one to wait a while before trying again.
image.zh: 分拣室里，机械臂把每封回信丢进三个篮子之一：绿色是“已送达”，橙色是“退回寄件人”，红色是“我们的错”。红篮子正在着火。一位顾客拿着被退回的橙色信件耸耸肩；拿秒表的职员则让下一位先等一会儿再来。

means.en: 2xx: success
means.zh: 2xx：成功

means.en: 4xx: the client must change the request; resending fails again
means.zh: 4xx：客户端得改请求，原样重发还会失败

means.en: 5xx: the server failed
means.zh: 5xx：服务器出错

means.en: retry 5xx or 429 later, with backoff, only if idempotent
means.zh: 5xx 或 429 稍后带退避重试，前提是幂等

summary.en: Return long lists in pages; cursor pagination over a stable, unique order with an opaque token stays correct and fast while data changes.
summary.zh: 长列表要分页返回；按稳定唯一的顺序、用不透明令牌做游标分页，数据变化时仍然正确又快。

explain.en: Offset pagination (LIMIT 20 OFFSET 40) is simple and can jump to page 3, but the database still walks past every skipped row, so deep pages get slow, and rows inserted or deleted between requests shift the window, causing repeats or gaps. Cursor (keyset) pagination remembers where the last page ended and asks for rows after it: WHERE (created_at, id) < (:t, :id) ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 20. With an index on the sort key each page costs about the same, and new rows do not shift it. The order must be stable and unique, so add a tie-breaker such as the id. Return the cursor as an opaque token (for example base64) so clients cannot depend on its format.
explain.zh: 偏移分页（LIMIT 20 OFFSET 40）简单，还能直接跳到第 3 页，但数据库仍要逐行走过被跳过的记录，页越深越慢；两次请求之间有插入或删除时，窗口会错位，造成重复或遗漏。游标分页（keyset）记住上一页结束的位置，只取它之后的行：WHERE (created_at, id) < (:t, :id) ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 20。排序键有索引时每页代价基本相同，新插入的行也不会让结果错位。顺序必须稳定且唯一，所以要加 id 这类决胜键。游标以不透明令牌（例如 base64）返回，客户端就无法依赖它的内部格式。

example.en: A feed shows 20 posts per page, newest first. A user reads page 1 (posts 100 to 81); meanwhile 5 new posts arrive. With OFFSET 20, page 2 now returns posts 85 to 66, repeating 85 to 81. With a cursor, page 2 asks for posts older than 81 and gets 80 to 61, no repeats. The response looks like {"items": [...], "next": "eyJpZCI6ODF9"}.
example.zh: 信息流每页 20 条，最新在前。用户看完第 1 页（第 100 到 81 条），这时来了 5 条新帖。用 OFFSET 20，第 2 页返回第 85 到 66 条，85 到 81 重复出现。用游标，第 2 页请求“比 81 更早”的帖子，得到第 80 到 61 条，没有重复。响应形如 {"items": [...], "next": "eyJpZCI6ODF9"}。

image.en: A conveyor belt carries parcels from left to right while a robot keeps shoving new ones on at the start. On the left, a clerk with a magnifying glass counts parcels from the beginning to find 'number 21' and keeps getting it wrong. On the right, a second clerk left a red flag where she stopped last time; now she simply takes the parcels after the flag.
image.zh: 传送带载着包裹从左往右走，一个机器人不停地往起点塞新包裹。左边的职员拿着放大镜从头数，想找到“第 21 个”，却总数错。右边的第二位职员上次在停下的地方插了一面红旗，现在只管拿红旗后面的包裹。

means.en: OFFSET: walks past skipped rows; inserts shift the window
means.zh: OFFSET：逐行跳过；插入会让窗口错位

thing.zh: 往起点塞包裹的机器人

means.en: concurrent inserts that cause repeats or gaps
means.zh: 并发插入造成重复或遗漏

means.en: the cursor: continue after the last key seen
means.zh: 游标：从见到的最后一个键之后继续

thing.en: a plain flag with no writing

means.en: an opaque token clients hand back unread
means.zh: 客户端原样交回的不透明令牌

summary.en: Evolve an API with additive, backward-compatible changes; keep new versions for breaking ones and give clients time to move.
summary.zh: 用增量、向后兼容的改动演进 API；只有破坏性改动才开新版本，并给客户端留出迁移时间。

explain.en: Once other teams depend on an API, its contract can only grow. Backward-compatible changes are additive: a new optional field, endpoint or parameter. Breaking changes remove or rename a field, change a type or meaning, make an optional input required, or tighten validation. Clients should ignore unknown fields (the tolerant reader) and servers should keep accepting old requests. When a break is unavoidable, publish a new version, run both side by side, announce a deprecation period (for example with Deprecation and Sunset headers) and watch traffic until the old version is idle. The version can live in the path (/v2/orders), a header or a media type: the path is most visible, a header keeps URLs stable.
explain.zh: 一旦别的团队依赖了某个 API，它的契约就只能扩展。向后兼容的改动是增量式的：新增可选字段、接口或参数。破坏性改动包括删除或重命名字段、改变类型或含义、把可选输入改为必填、收紧校验。客户端应忽略不认识的字段（容错读者），服务器应继续接受旧请求。实在要破坏兼容时，发布新版本并与旧版并行运行，公布弃用期（例如用 Deprecation 和 Sunset 响应头），持续观察流量直到旧版无人调用。版本号可以放在路径（/v2/orders）、请求头或媒体类型里：路径最直观，请求头让 URL 保持不变。

example.en: v1 returns {"name": "Ada Lovelace"}. Adding "email" next to it is safe. Splitting name into first_name and last_name breaks every client that reads name, so ship it as /v2/users, keep v1 running with a Sunset date six months out, and email the teams whose traffic still reaches v1.
example.zh: v1 返回 {"name": "Ada Lovelace"}。在旁边加一个 "email" 字段是安全的。把 name 拆成 first_name 和 last_name 会让所有读取 name 的客户端出错，所以应作为 /v2/users 发布，v1 继续运行并定下六个月后的 Sunset 日期，再给仍在调用 v1 的团队发邮件。

image.en: Two post boxes stand side by side: a faded blue one with an hourglass running out on its roof, and a shiny red new one. A signpost between them points to v1 and v2. An elderly customer still posts his letters into the old box, a newcomer uses the new one, and a clerk with a megaphone announces the day the old box will close.
image.zh: 两个邮筒并排而立：一个是褪色的蓝邮筒，顶上的沙漏快漏完了；另一个是崭新的红邮筒。两者之间的路牌分别指向 v1 和 v2。一位老顾客仍把信投进旧邮筒，新来的顾客用新邮筒，拿扩音器的职员正在宣布旧邮筒关闭的日子。

means.en: run the old and new versions side by side
means.zh: 新旧版本并行运行

means.en: a deprecation period with a sunset date
means.zh: 带停用日期的弃用期

thing.zh: 仍用 v1 的老顾客

means.en: existing clients keep working; nothing breaks overnight
means.zh: 现有客户端照常工作，不会一夜崩溃

means.en: announce deprecation and contact the remaining callers
means.zh: 公告弃用，联系剩下的调用方

means.en: the version lives in the path, header or media type
means.zh: 版本放在路径、请求头或媒体类型里

summary.en: Aim for high cohesion inside each module and low coupling between modules, which meet only through small, clear interfaces.
summary.zh: 模块内部高内聚，模块之间低耦合，彼此只通过小而清晰的接口连接。

explain.en: Cohesion measures how closely the parts of one module belong together; coupling measures how much modules depend on each other. High cohesion means a module does one job and the code for that job lives in one place. Low coupling means a change inside one module rarely forces changes in others. The tool is information hiding (Parnas, 1972): put each design decision that is likely to change behind a narrow interface, and let other modules use only that interface, never the internals or shared mutable data. Coupling cannot be zero, since modules must cooperate, but depending on a stable interface is far cheaper than depending on details. SOLID, layering and service boundaries all build on these two ideas.
explain.zh: 内聚衡量一个模块内部各部分关联得有多紧密；耦合衡量模块之间相互依赖的程度。高内聚指一个模块只做一件事，相关代码集中在一处；低耦合指改动一个模块的内部，很少迫使其他模块跟着改。手段是信息隐藏（Parnas，1972）：把每个可能变化的设计决策藏在窄接口后面，其他模块只使用接口，不碰内部实现或共享的可变数据。耦合不可能为零，模块总要协作，但依赖稳定的接口比依赖细节便宜得多。SOLID、分层和服务边界都建立在这两条原则之上。

example.en: A checkout module that reads the payments table directly is tightly coupled: renaming a column breaks checkout. If checkout calls payments.charge(order_id, amount) instead, the payments team can change tables, providers or retries without touching checkout. A utils.py that parses dates, sends email and renders PDFs has low cohesion; split it by job.
example.zh: 结账模块直接读支付表就是紧耦合：支付表改个列名，结账就坏了。改为调用 payments.charge(order_id, amount)，支付团队就能随意更换表结构、支付渠道或重试策略，而不必动结账代码。一个同时负责解析日期、发邮件和生成 PDF 的 utils.py 内聚很低，应按职责拆开。

image.en: On the left of the workshop a mechanic strains against a big gear train: turn one gear and the other two must turn with it. On the right stands a neat tower of blue, yellow and green toy bricks, each brick a single solid colour. A giant hand holds up a red brick beside the tower, ready to snap it on, because every brick has the same studs.
image.zh: 工坊左边，一位机械师使劲推着一组大齿轮：转动一个，另外两个也得跟着转。右边立着一座整齐的积木塔，蓝、黄、绿三块积木各是一种纯色。一只巨手在塔旁举起一块红积木，随时可以扣上去，因为每块积木的凸点都一模一样。

means.en: tight coupling: one change forces changes next door
means.zh: 紧耦合：一处改动牵连邻居

means.en: a small, stable interface
means.zh: 小而稳定的接口

thing.en: the red brick ready to snap on

means.en: low coupling: swap a module without touching the rest
means.zh: 低耦合：换掉一个模块不碰其余部分

means.en: high cohesion: one module, one job
means.zh: 高内聚：一个模块只做一件事

summary.en: Five object-oriented design principles that keep classes focused, extensible, substitutable, lean and decoupled.
summary.zh: 五条面向对象设计原则，让类职责单一、易于扩展、可以替换、接口精简、依赖解耦。

explain.en: S, single responsibility: a class should have one reason to change, that is, serve one actor. O, open/closed: open for extension, closed for modification; add a new class instead of editing a growing switch. L, Liskov substitution: a subtype must work wherever its base type is expected, keeping its contract (no stronger preconditions, no weaker postconditions). I, interface segregation: several small, client-specific interfaces beat one fat one. D, dependency inversion: high-level policy and low-level details both depend on abstractions, so business logic owns the interface and the database adapter implements it. They are heuristics, not laws; applied blindly they add needless indirection.
explain.zh: S，单一职责：一个类只应有一个变化的理由，即只服务于一类使用者。O，开闭原则：对扩展开放、对修改关闭，用新增类代替不断膨胀的 switch。L，里氏替换：凡是需要基类的地方都能换成子类，且不破坏契约（前置条件不能更强，后置条件不能更弱）。I，接口隔离：多个面向具体调用方的小接口胜过一个臃肿的大接口。D，依赖倒置：高层策略和底层细节都依赖抽象，由业务逻辑定义接口，数据库适配器去实现。它们是经验法则而非定律，机械套用只会添加多余的间接层。

example.en: S: move email sending out of UserService into a Mailer. O: add PayPal as a new PaymentMethod subclass, not another elif. L: a Square whose set_width also changes its height breaks code written for Rectangle. I: a read-only caller depends on Reader, not on a 20-method Repo. D: OrderService takes a Gateway interface that StripeGateway implements.
example.zh: S：发邮件从 UserService 移到 Mailer。O：PayPal 写成新的 PaymentMethod 子类，不再加 elif。L：改宽也改高的 Square 会破坏针对 Rectangle 写的代码。I：只读调用方依赖 Reader，而非 20 个方法的 Repo。D：OrderService 接收 Gateway 接口，由 StripeGateway 实现。

image.en: A yellow robot arm with a small standard socket waits on the workshop floor. Beside it lies a row of single-purpose heads, a hammer, a wrench and a pair of scissors, and each snaps on without opening the arm. But a rubber duck that needs a battery has sneaked in among the tools: it looks as if it belongs, yet it cannot do a tool's job. An engineer in a hard hat shrugs at it.
image.zh: 工坊地上，一台带小型标准接口的黄色机械臂在等待。旁边一排单一用途的工具头：锤子、扳手、剪刀，每个都不用拆开机械臂就能扣上。可是一只要装电池的橡皮鸭混进了工具堆：看起来像是同类，却干不了工具的活。戴安全帽的工程师冲它耸耸肩。

means.en: S: a single reason to change
means.zh: S：只有一个变化的理由

thing.en: heads snap on without opening the arm

means.en: O: extend without modifying
means.zh: O：扩展而不修改

thing.en: the duck that needs a battery

means.en: L: a subtype that breaks the base type's contract
means.zh: L：破坏基类契约的子类

means.en: I: lean interfaces with nothing a client does not use
means.zh: I：精简接口，不含调用方用不到的东西

thing.en: the arm knows only the socket

means.en: D: depend on abstractions, not on concrete tools
means.zh: D：依赖抽象，而非具体工具

summary.en: Hand an object its collaborators from outside instead of letting it build them, so they can be swapped and faked in tests.
summary.zh: 由外部把协作对象交给一个对象，而不是让它自己创建，这样就能替换，测试时也能换成假对象。

explain.en: Without injection a class builds what it needs: self.db = PostgresDB("prod-url"). It is then welded to that database, its configuration and its side effects. With dependency injection the class declares what it needs, usually as constructor parameters typed by an interface, and the code that assembles the application (the composition root) passes in real implementations. Tests pass fakes or stubs instead, with no network and no database. Injection is the usual way to apply the dependency inversion principle. A DI container (Spring, Guice, the one built into .NET) automates the wiring of large object graphs; it is optional, and plain constructor arguments are often enough. Avoid the service locator, which hides dependencies inside the class.
explain.zh: 不用注入时，类自己创建依赖：self.db = PostgresDB("prod-url")，于是它和这个数据库、它的配置及副作用焊死在一起。依赖注入让类声明自己需要什么，通常是以接口为类型的构造函数参数，由组装应用的代码（组合根）传入真实实现；测试时改传假对象或桩，不需要网络和数据库。注入是落实依赖倒置原则的常用方式。DI 容器（Spring、Guice、.NET 自带的容器）可为大型对象图自动装配，但它是可选的，直接传构造参数往往就够了。要避免服务定位器，它把依赖藏进了类的内部。

example.en: class Checkout: def __init__(self, payments: PaymentGateway, clock: Clock). Production: Checkout(StripeGateway(key), SystemClock()). Test: Checkout(FakeGateway(declines=True), FixedClock("2026-01-01")) checks in milliseconds that a declined card creates no order, without calling Stripe.
example.zh: Checkout 的构造函数接收 payments: PaymentGateway 和 clock: Clock。生产：Checkout(StripeGateway(key), SystemClock())。测试：Checkout(FakeGateway(declines=True), FixedClock("2026-01-01"))，几毫秒就能验证拒卡时不生成订单，且不调用 Stripe。

image.en: A big robot stands in the workshop with an empty battery hatch, and it has no way to make its own power. A giant hand reaches in from outside and holds up a gold battery for the production shift. On the test bench beside it lies a painted wooden battery, and an inspector points at it: with that one, the robot can be tried out without any real power.
image.zh: 工坊里站着一个大机器人，电池仓空着，它自己没法产生电力。一只巨手从外面伸进来，为生产班次举起一块金色电池。旁边的测试台上放着一块涂了漆的木头电池，检查员指着它：装上这块，不用真电也能试一试机器人。

means.en: the class declares what it needs instead of building it
means.zh: 类声明自己需要什么，而不自己创建

means.en: the composition root or a DI container passes it in
means.zh: 组合根或 DI 容器把依赖传进去

means.en: the real implementation in production
means.zh: 生产环境的真实实现

thing.en: the wooden battery on the test bench

means.en: a fake injected in tests: no network, no database
means.zh: 测试时注入的假对象：不连网络和数据库

summary.en: Strategy swaps an algorithm at runtime, Observer notifies subscribers of a change, Adapter makes an incompatible interface fit.
summary.zh: 策略模式在运行时替换算法，观察者模式向订阅者通知变化，适配器模式让不兼容的接口对上。

explain.en: Strategy: put a family of interchangeable algorithms behind one interface and choose one at runtime (shipping cost per courier, a sort order); it replaces a long if/else chain. Observer: a subject keeps a list of observers and notifies them when its state changes, so it need not know who reacts (UI listeners, domain events). Watch for leaks from forgotten subscriptions and for cascades that are hard to follow. Adapter: wrap an existing class so it offers the interface a client expects, changing neither side, for example wrapping a legacy XML payment SDK to implement your PaymentGateway. All three come from the 1994 'Gang of Four' book. Reach for them when the problem appears, not in advance.
explain.zh: 策略模式：把一族可互换的算法放在同一接口后面，运行时再选（按快递公司计算运费、选择排序方式），用来替代冗长的 if/else。观察者模式：主题维护一份观察者列表，状态变化时通知它们，主题无需知道谁在响应（界面监听器、领域事件）。要当心忘记退订造成的泄漏，以及难以追踪的连锁反应。适配器模式：包装一个现有类，让它提供调用方期望的接口，两边都不用改，比如把老旧的 XML 支付 SDK 包装成你的 PaymentGateway。三者都出自 1994 年的“四人帮”（GoF）一书。等问题真正出现时再用，不要提前套用。

example.en: Strategy: price = pricing.compute(cart), where pricing is RegularPricing or BlackFridayPricing, chosen from config. Observer: an order.placed event fires and the email, inventory and analytics listeners each react; adding a loyalty listener changes nothing else. Adapter: class LegacyPayAdapter(PaymentGateway) turns charge(amount) into the old SDK's doPayment(xml).
example.zh: 策略：price = pricing.compute(cart)，pricing 按配置取 RegularPricing 或 BlackFridayPricing。观察者：order.placed 触发，邮件、库存、分析监听器各自响应，加积分监听器无需改别处。适配器：LegacyPayAdapter(PaymentGateway) 把 charge(amount) 转成旧 SDK 的 doPayment(xml)。

image.en: In the middle of the workshop a big brass bell swings, and a dog and a cat on either side prick up their ears at the same moment. On the left a carpenter in a beret studies a signpost, 'ship' one way and 'fly' the other, choosing the delivery method only now. On the right a funnel sits in the neck of a slim bottle, so the fat barrel next to it can finally pour in.
image.zh: 工坊中央，一口大铜钟摇响，两边的狗和猫同时竖起耳朵。左边，戴贝雷帽的木匠盯着路牌，一边写“海运”，一边写“空运”，到这时才决定怎么发货。右边，一只漏斗插在细瓶口上，旁边的胖木桶终于能往里倒了。

means.en: Observer: the subject announces a change
means.zh: 观察者：主题宣布状态变化

thing.en: dog and cat reacting at once

means.en: subscribers are notified; the subject need not know them
means.zh: 订阅者收到通知，主题不必认识它们

means.en: Strategy: pick an interchangeable algorithm at runtime
means.zh: 策略：运行时选择可互换的算法

thing.zh: 木桶和瓶子之间的漏斗

means.en: Adapter: make an incompatible interface fit
means.zh: 适配器：让不兼容的接口对上

summary.en: A commit is a snapshot of the whole project named by a hash; branches are movable pointers, and HEAD marks where you are.
summary.zh: 提交是整个项目的快照，以哈希命名；分支是可移动的指针，HEAD 标明你所在的位置。

explain.en: Git stores snapshots, not diffs. A commit records a tree (the full project state; unchanged files are shared, not copied), its parent commits, the author and a message. Its id is a hash of that content (SHA-1 by default, SHA-256 optionally), so changing anything in a commit or its ancestry changes the id. Parent links make history a directed acyclic graph; a merge commit has two parents. A branch is just a movable pointer to one commit, stored as a tiny file, and committing moves the current branch forward. HEAD names what is checked out, normally a branch; pointing it straight at a commit gives a 'detached HEAD'. Tags are pointers that do not move. Diffs are computed on demand by comparing snapshots.
explain.zh: Git 存的是快照，不是差异。一个提交记录一棵树（项目的完整状态，未改动的文件共享而非复制）、父提交、作者和说明。提交的 id 是对这些内容取的哈希（默认 SHA-1，可选 SHA-256），所以改动提交本身或它的任何祖先都会改变 id。父链接让历史成为有向无环图，合并提交有两个父提交。分支只是指向某个提交的可移动指针，存成一个小文件，提交时当前分支随之前移。HEAD 表示当前检出的位置，通常指向分支；直接指向某个提交就是“分离 HEAD”。标签是不会移动的指针。差异是比较两个快照时临时算出来的。

example.en: git commit on main creates commit a3f9c2e with parent 71bd04e and moves main to a3f9c2e. git switch -c fix creates the pointer fix at the same commit and points HEAD at it. Two more commits on fix move only fix; main still points to a3f9c2e. git log --graph --oneline --all draws the graph.
example.zh: 在 main 上 git commit：生成提交 a3f9c2e，父提交是 71bd04e，main 移到 a3f9c2e。git switch -c fix 在同一提交上创建指针 fix，并让 HEAD 指向它。在 fix 上再提交两次，只有 fix 前移，main 仍指向 a3f9c2e。git log --graph --oneline --all 可以画出这张图。

image.en: A steam train stands at the platform, its carriage hooked to the engine like a commit to its parent. Before anything new is coupled on, a photographer with a big camera on a crate shoots the whole station, so every carriage carries a complete picture, not a list of changes. A red flag reading 'main' is planted at the newest end of the train, and the conductor, HEAD, points at it, ready to move it forward.
image.zh: 一列蒸汽火车停在站台，车厢挂在机车后面，就像提交连着它的父提交。每挂上新车厢之前，摄影师都会用木箱上的大相机把整个车站拍下来，所以每节车厢装的是一张完整的照片，而不是改动清单。写着“main”的红旗插在列车最新的一端，列车长 HEAD 指着它，随时准备把它往前挪。

means.en: each commit points to its parent: history is a graph
means.zh: 每个提交指向父提交：历史是一张图

means.en: a commit stores a full snapshot, not a diff
means.zh: 提交保存完整快照，而非差异

means.en: a branch: a movable pointer to the newest commit
means.zh: 分支：指向最新提交的可移动指针

means.en: HEAD: what you have checked out
means.zh: HEAD：当前检出的位置

summary.en: Trunk-based development merges small, short-lived branches into main every day; Git Flow keeps long-lived develop and release branches.
summary.zh: 主干开发每天把短命的小分支合入 main；Git Flow 则维护长期存在的 develop 和 release 分支。

explain.en: A branching strategy sets how work flows into the shared code. In trunk-based development everyone integrates into main at least daily, through short-lived branches and small pull requests (or direct commits backed by strong CI); unfinished features hide behind feature flags, and main stays releasable. Merges stay small, which suits continuous delivery. Git Flow (2010) keeps long-lived main and develop branches plus feature, release and hotfix branches; it fits software shipped in numbered versions but tends to produce large, late merges. GitHub flow is a lighter middle path: branch from main, open a pull request, review, merge, deploy. Long-lived branches drift apart and merge painfully, which is why most web teams now prefer trunk-based work.
explain.zh: 分支策略规定工作如何汇入共享代码。主干开发（trunk-based development）要求每个人至少每天向 main 集成一次，通过短命分支和小型拉取请求（或在可靠 CI 保障下直接提交）；未完成的功能藏在特性开关后面，main 始终可发布。每次合并都很小，契合持续交付。Git Flow（2010）维护长期存在的 main 和 develop，外加 feature、release、hotfix 分支，适合按版本号发布的软件，但容易造成又大又晚的合并。GitHub flow 是更轻的折中：从 main 拉分支、提拉取请求、评审、合并、部署。长期分支会越走越远，合并时很痛苦，所以如今多数 Web 团队偏爱主干开发。

example.en: Trunk-based: Mia branches add-coupon-field at 10:00, opens a 60-line pull request at 14:00, and it is reviewed and merged by 16:00; the half-built coupon page stays behind a flag. Git Flow: a team works on feature branches off develop for three weeks, cuts release/2.4, fixes bugs there, then merges it into main and back into develop.
example.zh: 主干开发：Mia 上午 10 点拉出分支 add-coupon-field，下午 2 点提交 60 行的拉取请求，4 点前评审并合并；做了一半的优惠券页面藏在开关后面。Git Flow：团队在从 develop 拉出的 feature 分支上干三周，再拉出 release/2.4，在上面修 bug，最后合入 main 并回合到 develop。

image.en: On platform 1 the main-line train is boarding. Porters hurry up every few minutes, each with a single envelope, and toss it aboard, so nothing waits long; the giant station clock marks the day. Off to the side sits an enormous crate that has waited for weeks, with weeds sprouting on its lid, and it will no longer fit through the carriage door.
image.zh: 一号站台上，干线列车正在上客。搬运工每隔几分钟就跑过来，每人只拿一个信封，往车上一扔，什么都不会久等；巨大的站台钟记着日子。旁边搁着一只等了好几周的大木箱，箱盖上都长出了杂草，已经塞不进车厢门了。

means.en: main, the trunk: always ready to depart
means.zh: main，即主干：随时可以发车

thing.zh: 每人一个信封的搬运工

means.en: short-lived branches and small pull requests
means.zh: 短命分支和小型拉取请求

means.en: integrate into main at least once a day
means.zh: 至少每天向 main 集成一次

means.en: a long-lived branch: it drifts and merges painfully
means.zh: 长期分支：越走越远，合并痛苦

summary.en: Merge joins two histories with a merge commit; rebase replays your commits onto a new base. Never rebase commits others already have.
summary.zh: 合并用合并提交把两段历史连起来；变基把你的提交重放到新的基点上。别人已拿到的提交不要变基。

explain.en: When main and your branch have both moved on, git merge creates a merge commit with two parents: history stays exactly as it happened, at the cost of a branching graph. git rebase main instead replays each of your commits on top of the current main, creating new commits with new hashes and a straight line of history; conflicts are resolved one commit at a time. Because rebase rewrites commits, never rebase commits others have pulled: their copies still hold the old ones, and their next pull tangles old and new together. A common team rule: rebase your private branch to stay current, then merge it, or squash-merge it, through a pull request. git pull --rebase does the same for local work.
explain.zh: 当 main 和你的分支都各自前进后，git merge 生成一个有两个父提交的合并提交：历史按真实发生的样子保留，代价是提交图出现分叉。git rebase main 则把你的每个提交重放到当前 main 之上，生成哈希全新的提交，历史成一条直线；冲突要逐个提交解决。变基会改写提交，所以绝不要对别人已经拉取的提交变基：他们手里仍是旧提交，下次拉取时新旧两份会纠缠在一起。常见的团队约定：私有分支用变基跟上 main，再通过拉取请求合并或压缩合并。git pull --rebase 对本地工作也是这么做的。

example.en: main has commits A–B–C; your branch has A–X–Y. git merge main on your branch adds a merge commit M whose parents are Y and C. git rebase main instead gives A–B–C–X'–Y': X' and Y' carry the same changes as X and Y but have new hashes, so you must force-push the branch with git push --force-with-lease.
example.zh: main 上是 A–B–C，你的分支是 A–X–Y。在分支上 git merge main，会新增合并提交 M，父提交是 Y 和 C。改用 git rebase main，得到 A–B–C–X'–Y'：X' 和 Y' 的改动与 X、Y 相同，但哈希是新的，所以要用 git push --force-with-lease 强推分支。

image.en: A crane on the platform lifts your blue wagon off its old siding and swings it over to the end of the main-line wagons, where it will get a fresh number plate. The operator only ever lifts his own wagon. On the left is the other way to join up: the green wagon stays exactly where it stood, and a heavy chain couples it to the main line.
image.zh: 站台上的吊车把你的蓝色货车厢从旧岔道上吊起，转到干线车厢的末尾，放下后它会换上新的车号牌。操作员只吊自己的车厢。左边是另一种接法：绿色车厢原地不动，一条粗铁链把它和干线连在一起。

means.en: rebase: replay your commits on top of the new tip
means.zh: 变基：把你的提交重放到最新的顶端

means.en: rebased commits are new commits with new hashes
means.zh: 变基后的提交是哈希全新的新提交

means.en: merge: a merge commit joins both histories as they were
means.zh: 合并：合并提交把两段历史原样连起来

thing.en: he lifts only his own wagon

means.en: never rebase commits that others have pulled
means.zh: 别人拉取过的提交绝不变基

summary.en: git revert adds a new commit that cancels an old one; git reset moves a branch pointer; the reflog remembers where HEAD has been.
summary.zh: git revert 新增一个提交来抵消旧提交；git reset 移动分支指针；reflog 记得 HEAD 去过的位置。

explain.en: git revert <commit> creates a new commit whose changes are the inverse of the old one. History only grows, so it safely undoes pushed, shared work. git reset moves the current branch pointer to another commit: --soft keeps the changes staged, --mixed (the default) keeps them in the working tree, --hard throws them away. Reset rewrites the branch, so use it only on commits nobody else has. git restore discards uncommitted edits to files. After a bad reset the commits are not gone at once: the reflog records every position of HEAD and of each branch (by default for 90 days, or 30 for unreachable entries), so git reflog shows the old hash and git reset --hard <hash> brings it back. Uncommitted work wiped by reset --hard is truly lost.
explain.zh: git revert <提交> 生成一个新提交，内容恰好抵消旧提交的改动。历史只增不减，适合撤销已推送的内容。git reset 把当前分支指针移到另一个提交：--soft 把改动留在暂存区，--mixed（默认）留在工作区，--hard 直接丢弃。reset 会改写分支，只能用于没人拿到的提交。git restore 丢弃文件里未提交的修改。reset 错了，提交也不会立刻消失：reflog 记录 HEAD 和各分支去过的每个位置（默认保留 90 天，不可达条目 30 天），用 git reflog 找到旧哈希，再 git reset --hard <哈希> 即可找回。但 reset --hard 抹掉的未提交改动无法找回。

example.en: A pushed commit 9e1d4b2 broke the build: git revert 9e1d4b2 adds commit c07f311 that undoes it, and teammates simply pull. You made two local commits by mistake: git reset --soft HEAD~2 removes them and keeps the edits staged. You ran git reset --hard HEAD~3 by accident: git reflog shows HEAD@{1} at 4a5b6c7, and git reset --hard 4a5b6c7 restores it.
example.zh: 已推送的提交 9e1d4b2 搞坏了构建：git revert 9e1d4b2 新增提交 c07f311 抵消它，队友直接拉取即可。本地误提交了两次：git reset --soft HEAD~2 撤掉这两个提交，改动仍在暂存区。不小心执行了 git reset --hard HEAD~3：git reflog 显示 HEAD@{1} 在 4a5b6c7，git reset --hard 4a5b6c7 即可恢复。

image.en: Three wagons stand on the track, and the last one is painted red: a bad commit. Next to it stands a mirror holding its reversed image, coupled on like one more wagon, so the train only grows.
